title: YAM — Contract Vulnerability
summary_ko: SlowMist: YAM — Contract Vulnerability, loss $ 750,000. On August 13, 2020, the well-known Ethereum DeFi project YAM officially issued a post on Twitter indicating that there were loopholes in the contract. The price plummeted by 99% within 24 hours, resulting in the “permanent destruction” of the governance contract, with a value of 750,000 USD Curve tokens. It is locked and cannot be used. Since the value of totalSupply was taken during rebase, the value of totalSupply calculated incorrectly will not be immediately applied to initSupply through mint, so before the next rebase, the community still has a chance to recover this error and reduce losses. But once the next rebase is executed, the entire mistake will become irreparable.

title: Bitcoin ATM — Scam
summary_ko: 2020년 8월 15일 Bitcoin ATM에서 사기로 $30,000가 탈취됐으며, 이는 해당 사기의 피해액이다.

title: OKEx — 51% attack

title: Degen.Money — Double Authorization Vulnerability
summary_ko: SlowMist: Degen.Money — Double Authorization Vulnerability, loss -. The first authorization gives the pledge contract, and the second authorization gives the right to transfer money, which will result in the user's funds being taken away by the attacker. YFI founder Andre Cronje says the project does have risks.
